name: acoustic guitar
caption: An acoustic guitar with a waisted body, a round sound hole and a long neck. A waisted body joins a long neck; the headstock carries tuning studs. Curved body edges keep an even thickness around the sound hole. Overall width is 0.75 times depth; height is 2.30 times width. Parts follow functional positions. Continuous dark brown, tan, near black color regions distinguish the body and attachments. The front reveals functional parts; side and top views reveal depth, connections and layout.
